content: WASM works in all MV3 extension contexts (service worker, content scripts, popup) but requires 'wasm-unsafe-eval' in content_security_policy.extension_pages since MV3 dropped unsafe-eval; safest load path is fetch() the .wasm as ArrayBuffer then WebAssembly.instantiate() rather than instantiateStreaming from a blob/moz-extension URL, which has had compatibility issues historically.
